title: Require Recipe Stage Source Topology
forbids: recipe stage collections or semantic containers outside the closed recipe-stage blueprint topology, including recipe-owned artifact directories
why: Physical stage source may nest by semantic hierarchy independently of runtime stage IDs. Every semantic container admits only nested kebab-case containers or canonical support surfaces. An index.ts marks that container as an authored stage; containers without one remain non-stage family containers. Structure-v1 admits public.config.ts as a canonical support filename at either kind of semantic container and does not by itself prove stage ownership; the authoring law separately requires a stage index to import only its immediate sibling public configuration. Steps are a reserved subtree owned by the recipe-step blueprint, while immutable pipeline data-product contracts remain with their domain owner.
remediate: Place source under a semantic stage container, keep public.config.ts adjacent to any stage index that consumes it, use the canonical support filenames, move immutable artifact contracts to the producing domain, and delete engine observations or diagnostic projections that are not artifacts. Do not infer stage ownership from public.config.ts alone.
message: Recipe stage source must match the positive recursive semantic-container topology.
